title: Warm Silky Chinese Tofu Char Siu
description: A floral and silky Chinese dish featuring ras el hanout and lacto-vegetarian friendly ingredients, originating from Xinjiang cuisine, served in a char siu style.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into char siu style strips

instructions: Press the tofu strips to remove excess moisture.
In a blender or food processor, combine ras el hanout, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and blend until smooth.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the tofu strips and cook until golden brown.
Pour the ras el hanout mixture over the tofu and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped green onions.
Transfer the tofu to a serving plate and serve warm.
Garnish with additional green onions if desired.
